ratings.reviewer_notes: Directly links EV-delivered miR-483-5p to impaired BMSC osteogenesis and osteoporosis in an Alzheimer's disease context through inhibition of IGF2.
Directly demonstrates that miR-15b suppresses osteoblast differentiation and aggravates osteoporosis through the USP7/KDM6B axis.
Directly links elevated miR-23a-5p to impaired osteogenic differentiation and postmenopausal osteoporosis via ALX3.
Provides direct evidence that miR-21 promotes osteoblast differentiation and mineralization, but it does not study an osteoporosis model.
Assesses miR-23a in bone formation and homeostasis and reports limited in vivo effects, but does not directly investigate osteoporosis.
Broad review of miRNAs in osteogenesis, bone homeostasis, and osteoporosis; useful contextual evidence but no specific miRNA–osteoporosis relationship is given in the abstract.
Mechanistically links the miR-23a/27a/24-2 cluster to suppression of osteoblast differentiation through RUNX2 and SATB2, but lacks an osteoporosis disease model.

Directly studies miR-582-3p in osteoporosis tissues and osteogenic differentiation through HOXA10. The stated conclusion about inhibiting osteoporosis appears inconsistent with the reported anti-osteogenic findings.
Links miR-21 to osteoporosis-related bone loss, but the primary in vivo mechanism is osteoclast function; osteogenesis is only adjacent evidence.
Reviews microbiota–miRNA interactions in osteoporosis but does not identify a specific miRNA linked to osteogenesis in the abstract.
Review-level context on dysregulated miRNAs, oxidative stress, reduced osteoblastogenesis, and osteoporosis, without naming a specific osteogenic miRNA in the abstract.
Reviews osteoporosis and osteogenesis in relation to the gut microbiota and mentions microRNA mediation, but provides no specific miRNA relationship in the abstract.
Directly shows that EV-delivered miR-23a and miR-30a inhibit osteoblastogenesis and bone formation, contributing to osteoporosis-associated bone disease in systemic mastocytosis.
Directly links reduced miR-21 in ovariectomy-induced osteoporosis to BMSC differentiation and shows that miR-21 promotes osteogenesis via PTEN.
Broad review of miRNAs regulating bone formation, resorption, and osteoporosis; relevant context but no individual miRNA is identified in the abstract.
Focused review directly links miR-23a to osteoporosis progression through inhibition of osteogenesis, increased bone resorption, and macrophage inflammatory polarization.
Studies METTL14-mediated m6A regulation of SMAD1 in osteoporosis and osteogenesis, not a miRNA.
Directly links elevated miR-214 to reduced bone formation in human specimens and osteoporosis models and identifies ATF4 as its osteoblast target.
Directly demonstrates that muscle-derived EV miR-873-3p promotes BMSC osteogenesis through CNN2 and improves bone mass in osteoporosis mice.
Review-level evidence on multiple miRNAs and lncRNA–miRNA interactions in osteogenesis and related disorders, without a clear osteoporosis-specific link in the abstract.
Directly identifies miR-1224-5p as an osteogenic regulator that promotes osteoblast differentiation and ameliorates estrogen-deficiency and age-related osteoporosis via ADCY2/Rap1 signaling.
Review of miRNAs in osteogenesis and osteoporosis, highlighting miR-218 in osteoblastogenesis and miR-148a in osteoclastogenesis, but offering broad rather than direct disease-specific evidence.
Directly shows that mechanically induced myoblast exosomal miR-92a-3p promotes BMSC osteogenic differentiation and treats glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis through PTEN/AKT signaling.
